text: よいが　さめるまで　まつしかないわ

structure.jp: よいが　さめるまで

structure.en: there's nothing to do but wait

patterns.name: 〜しかない
patterns.explanation: しかない after a verb says that this is the only thing you can do. まつしかない = 'can only wait'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.explanation: まで after a verb means 'until that happens'. さめるまで = 'until it wears off'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end softens the sentence in a womanly way. まつしかないわ = 'we can only wait, you know'.
